# Core Code ownership registry

<!-- Generated from governance/boundaries.json. Do not edit this file directly. -->

Core Code has one human Owner/Project Lead and a non-fixed number of human maintainers. A maintainer may own one or several boundaries; these rows are responsibility units, not seats. The Owner retains final override authority.

## Enforcement state

- Mode: `bootstrap`
- Project Owner: Jamal Cao (`@fr0m-scratch`)
- Source of truth: [`governance/boundaries.json`](governance/boundaries.json)

> Bootstrap is honest pre-enforcement state: boundaries are claimable, but GitHub cannot request accountable code-owner review until the Owner records explicit public identities and switches the registry to `active`.

## Boundary contracts

### `project-governance` — Project governance

Human authority, maintainership, generated ownership views, and the machine boundary registry.

- Contracts: `owner-override`, `one-human-one-agent`, `dynamic-boundary-registry`, `open-source-license`
- Required checks: `core-xtask boundaries check`

### `community-entry` — Community entry

Public project introduction, contribution workflow, pull request shape, and issue intake.

- Contracts: `issue-to-boundary-to-pr`, `human-accountability`
- Required checks: `core-xtask boundaries check`

### `security-policy` — Security policy

Public support, vulnerability reporting, disclosure, and security response policy.

- Contracts: `responsible-disclosure`, `security-support-boundary`
- Required checks: `core-xtask boundaries check`

### `architecture-roadmap` — Architecture and roadmap

Publicly truthful current architecture, target boundaries, milestones, and limitations.

- Contracts: `current-implementation-truth`, `microkernel-roadmap`
- Required checks: `core-xtask boundaries check`

### `build-release` — Build and release

Workspace membership, dependency lock, repository checks, CI, artifacts, and release gates.

- Contracts: `workspace-dependency-baseline`, `required-rust-gates`, `generated-boundary-drift`
- Required checks: `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `core-xtask boundaries check`

### `protocol-compat` — Protocol compatibility

Versioned submissions, events, identity, trust, permission, message, and tool contracts.

- Contracts: `runtime-protocol`, `durable-event-schema`, `permission-schema`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-protocol --locked`

### `kernel-runtime` — Kernel runtime

Turn state machine, admission, budgets, orchestration execution, and frontend event seam.

- Contracts: `turn-state-machine`, `bounded-run`, `single-writer`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-kernel --locked`

### `kernel-effects` — Kernel effects

Effect admission, durable intent ordering, terminal or unknown outcome, and reconciliation.

- Contracts: `intent-execute-terminal`, `unknown-effect-block`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-kernel effects --locked`

### `kernel-hooks` — Kernel hooks

Lifecycle hook admission, bounded child processes, environment policy, and hook evidence.

- Contracts: `trusted-hook-origin`, `bounded-hook-process`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-kernel hooks --locked`

### `record-core` — Record core

Append-only journal, hash chain, replay, checkpoint, recovery, and redaction.

- Contracts: `append-only-record`, `hash-chain`, `torn-tail-recovery`, `secret-redaction`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-record --locked`

### `record-sessions` — Record sessions

Session metadata, listing, fork lineage, resume projection, and tenant scoping.

- Contracts: `fork-aware-replay`, `tenant-scoped-session`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-record session --locked`

### `observability` — Observability

Usage ledger, cost truth, runtime metrics, and mergeable child-run accounting.

- Contracts: `cost-state`, `usage-ledger`, `no-invented-price`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-obs --locked`

### `scheduler` — Scheduler

Retry, backoff, concurrency governor, and memo policy.

- Contracts: `bounded-retry`, `bounded-concurrency`, `pre-stream-retry-only`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-sched --locked`

### `provider-core` — Provider core

Provider trait, route identity, errors, catalog, health, capabilities, and shared stream parsing.

- Contracts: `provider-port`, `catalog-truth`, `typed-provider-error`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-provider --locked`

### `provider-adapters` — Provider adapters

Anthropic Messages, OpenAI-compatible Chat, and OpenAI Responses wire adapters.

- Contracts: `stream-to-turn-result`, `native-state-scope`, `effort-application`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-provider --locked`

### `mcp-interop` — MCP interoperability

MCP process lifecycle, framing, tools, deadlines, and definite or unknown outcomes.

- Contracts: `mcp-framing`, `bounded-mcp-lifecycle`, `unknown-external-effect`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-mcp --locked`

### `context-core` — Context core

Compaction, instruction trust, source access, outline, and stable context estimation.

- Contracts: `untrusted-instruction-framing`, `bounded-context`, `compaction-policy`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-ctx --locked`

### `context-knowledge` — Context knowledge

Memory and skill discovery, trust, storage, bounded recall, and progressive disclosure.

- Contracts: `memory-provenance`, `bounded-recall`, `skill-progressive-disclosure`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-ctx --locked`

### `agent-catalog` — Agent catalog

Agent definitions, discovery, trust, read-only tool filtering, and catalog diagnostics.

- Contracts: `read-only-agent-authority`, `agent-definition-trust`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-agents --locked`

### `agent-orchestration` — Agent orchestration

Task classification, decomposition, deterministic Fan and Reduce policy, and workflow data.

- Contracts: `single-writer-fan-reduce`, `declaration-order-reduction`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-agents --locked`

### `evolution-control` — Evolution control

Offline policy, trajectory, evidence, and promotion contracts without runtime authority.

- Contracts: `no-runtime-activation`, `immutable-policy-reference`, `governed-promotion`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-evolve --locked`

### `sandbox` — Sandbox

Platform confinement, child environment, process groups, output bounds, and egress policy.

- Contracts: `workspace-confinement`, `egress-off-default`, `bounded-child-process`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-sandbox --locked`

### `tools-core` — Tools core

Tool registry, capability and purity coupling, filesystem, edit, and Git tools.

- Contracts: `tool-abi`, `workspace-path-boundary`, `purity-capability-coupling`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-tools --locked`

### `tools-execution` — Tools execution

Code execution, external web egress, deadlines, output bounds, and external effects.

- Contracts: `sandboxed-code-execution`, `ssrf-boundary`, `external-effect-classification`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-tools --locked`

### `tools-context` — Tools context

Memory and skill tool adapters that preserve source trust and progressive disclosure.

- Contracts: `memory-tool-trust`, `skill-tool-read-only`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-tools --locked`

### `verification` — Verification

Oracle strength, sandboxed test oracle, deterministic candidate ranking, and veto rules.

- Contracts: `oracle-strength`, `strong-veto`, `deterministic-selection`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-verify --locked`

### `evaluation` — Evaluation

Benchmark tasks, fixed-model component toggles, scoring, and reliability evidence.

- Contracts: `fixed-model-comparison`, `ground-truth-check`, `honest-quality-claim`
- Required checks: `cargo check -p core-eval --all-targets --locked`

### `cli-host` — CLI host

Composition root, trusted configuration, provider routing, commands, MCP wiring, and run lifecycle.

- Contracts: `trusted-config-precedence`, `runtime-composition`, `provider-selection`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-cli --locked`

### `cli-tui` — CLI TUI

Interactive state, input routing, composer, permission UX, sessions, terminal lifecycle, and PTY behavior.

- Contracts: `single-enter-input`, `terminal-restoration`, `permission-decision-surface`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-cli tui --locked`, `cargo test -p core-cli --test tui_pty --locked`

### `cli-render` — CLI rendering

Semantic blocks, markdown, syntax highlighting, layout, theme, and cell-width correctness.

- Contracts: `terminal-cell-bounds`, `semantic-transcript`, `accessible-theme`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-cli --locked`

### `cli-output` — CLI machine output

Text, JSON, stream-JSON, event scrubbing, exit codes, and machine-readable result contracts.

- Contracts: `machine-output-schema`, `stable-exit-code`, `streaming-redaction`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p core-cli output --locked`

## Claiming or changing ownership

1. Open an ownership-claim issue naming the boundary, proposed human primary, reviewer or backup, adjacent contracts, and handoff plan.
2. The Owner confirms the appointment. An agent cannot claim, approve, inherit, or exercise a human boundary.
3. Update `governance/boundaries.json`, run `cargo run --locked -p core-xtask -- boundaries generate`, and submit both generated files.
4. Run `cargo run --locked -p core-xtask -- boundaries check`. Active enforcement requires every critical boundary and independent overlay to be assigned; critical primaries and affected primaries cannot self-review.
5. A person may claim several coherent boundaries. Maintainer count is never encoded as a quota.
